name: Stake $1 on ArcMind — Earn the First Mover NFT
summary: Stake at least 1 USDC into the live ArcMind ETH/USDC copy-trade market on Arc L1 testnet. Receive a non-transferable badge proving you were an early user of the first ERC-8004/8183-compliant autonomous trading agent.

steps.label: Connect a wallet that can reach Arc Testnet
Stake ≥ 1 USDC on the ArcMind ETH/USDC market

rewards.name: ArcMind First Mover
rewards.description: Awarded to the first 1,000 users who staked into ArcMind during Agora Agents hackathon week (May 17–25 2026).

notes: Galxe team must mirror these step IDs into their dashboard. Filter on the Staked event must enforce minAmount=1000000 (1 USDC, 6 decimals).
step_record is optional; primary completion comes from step_stake on-chain proof. Adding the API check ensures the receipt was indexed before the OAT is granted.
No private user data is collected — only the wallet address that signed the stake.
